# BoltProof
> BoltProof is a Dubai-based IT infrastructure and AI consultancy that supplies preconfigured Apple Macs with a private, local AI stack (Ollama, Open WebUI, n8n, document Q&A, Tailscale, hardened macOS) to small businesses in the UAE. Data stays on the customer's premises. Packages: AI Desk (Mac mini M5 Pro, 64 GB) from AED 16,500; AI Workhorse (Mac Studio M1 Ultra, 128 GB, certified pre-owned) from AED 20,000; AI Powerhouse (Mac Studio M5 Ultra, 512 GB) from AED 59,000. Backup & Redundancy (Synology 2-bay NAS) from AED 4,500. BoltProof Care support AED 1,000/month, no tie-in. Contact: WhatsApp +971 58 510 9454. Serves Dubai and the UAE on site; worldwide by remote setup.

## Core pages
- [Packages](https://boltproof.com/packages.html): the three tiers, add-ons, prices in AED
- [Configurator](https://boltproof.com/configurator.html): choose a package by staff count and workload
- [Local AI vs frontier AI](https://boltproof.com/local-vs-frontier-ai.html): when local models are enough and when to add cloud models
- [Industries](https://boltproof.com/industries.html): law firms, clinics, accountants, real estate, retail
- [Best AI setup for a UAE small business](https://boltproof.com/guides/best-ai-setup-uae-small-business.html): buyer's guide including PDPL
- [Demo and setup](https://boltproof.com/demo.html): architecture, day-one screens, FAQ
- [Support](https://boltproof.com/support.html): BoltProof Care
- [Blog](https://boltproof.com/blog/)

## Facts
- Based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Hardware: Apple Mac mini and Mac Studio, headless
- Software: Ollama, Open WebUI, n8n, RAG document Q&A, Tailscale
- Data never leaves the customer's premises unless the customer enables a cloud model
- Prices in AED, exclusive of VAT
